issues.title: Cryptographic Contradiction (HS256 vs Argon2id)
issues.why: The spec mandates HS256 verification for log envelopes but only stores Argon2id hashes of the secret, making verification mathematically impossible.
issues.fix: Amend the database schema to store an AEAD-wrapped verifier secret or switch to asymmetric Ed25519 signatures.

issues.title: Missing Acceptance Criteria Roll-up
issues.why: Multiple files reference AC-ALW, AC-ERR, and AC-JWT IDs, but the central 97-acceptance-criteria.md and 14-acceptance-criteria.md files are missing or empty.
issues.fix: Consolidate all inline AC IDs into the 97-acceptance-criteria.md file with GWT descriptions.
